title: User
description: A document in the 'users' collection. The document ID is the user's uid.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID; matches the document ID.

birthday.description: Firestore timestamp, represented as an RFC 3339 date-time string.

created_time.description: Firestore timestamp, represented as an RFC 3339 date-time string.

photo_url.description: Firebase Storage download URL for the profile photo.
